init.title: Store Route Options
init.description: Edit list routing, ignore phrases, typo/brand corrections, and exact product IDs. All inputs are completely case-insensitive (e.g. 'Milk' and 'milk' match identically). One entry per line. For corrections use: wrong = correct

data_description.ignore_items: List headers/noise phrases to skip completely. Case-insensitive (e.g. 'Shopping List' matches 'shopping list').
data_description.typo_fixes: Map messy voice/OCR text to the search term you want. Case-insensitive. Example: yogrt = yogurt
data_description.direct_product_ids: Bypass search with an exact Kroger product ID/UPC. Case-insensitive. Example: Maple Syrup = 0001111050123
